reports.verdict: CoreWeave raised its 2026 outlook and backlog jumped to $132.5B, but rising interest costs and $37-39B of spending keep losses deep.

takeaways.label: Growth and guidance
takeaways.text: Revenue was $3.66B, up about 168% from a year ago and above the $3.45-3.6B target. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance rose to $13.0-13.3B.

takeaways.label: Backlog keeps swelling
takeaways.text: Contracted backlog reached about $132.5B, up from about $104B last quarter. Roughly $9B of customer prepayments and deposits are expected over the next three months.

takeaways.label: Debt costs weigh
takeaways.text: Net loss was $709M as interest expense hit $846M. Q4 interest is guided to $1.05-1.15B, and the company raised $4.2B in convertible notes.

takeaways.label: Spending stays huge
takeaways.text: 2026 capital spending is guided to $37-39B, with the low end raised, as capacity gets delivered sooner than planned. Adjusted operating margin was 10%, versus 16% a year ago.

reports.verdict: Trump Media's $410 million profit is bitcoin and investment gains, not business strength; the TAE fusion merger vote on December 14 is what matters.

takeaways.label: Profit is paper gains
takeaways.text: Net income of $409.7 million came from $496.1 million of mostly non-cash gains on bitcoin and investments. Adjusted EBITDA, which strips those out, was still a $12.3 million loss.

takeaways.label: Media business still tiny
takeaways.text: Revenue was $3.0 million, up 205% from $1.0 million, driven by subscriptions including the Truth API launched August 1. It remains far too small to matter next to the bitcoin holdings.

takeaways.label: TAE merger vote set
takeaways.text: The SEC cleared the merger filing on November 5. Shareholders vote December 14, and the company still targets a Q4 2026 close, pending approvals.

takeaways.label: Legal drag ends
takeaways.text: Legal fees fell to $2.4 million from $20.3 million a year earlier, and the company says legacy legal matters are resolved. Management plans tighter institutional management of the bitcoin.

reports.verdict: Berkshire is putting its huge cash pile to work through buybacks, but weaker GEICO car-insurance profit pulled core earnings down 6%.

takeaways.label: Buybacks accelerate
takeaways.text: Berkshire repurchased about $9.6 billion of its own stock in the quarter and $14.4 billion this year, roughly double the prior quarter's pace and a break from Buffett-era restraint.

takeaways.label: GEICO drags insurance
takeaways.text: Insurance underwriting profit fell 43% to $1.35 billion. GEICO earned $982 million before tax versus $1.77 billion a year earlier, as accident claims and advertising costs rose.

takeaways.label: Core earnings dip
takeaways.text: Operating earnings fell about 6% to $12.7 billion. BNSF railroad grew 19% and manufacturing and utilities rose, but insurance and lower investment income outweighed them.

takeaways.label: Deals and cash
takeaways.text: Berkshire paid $6.8 billion in July for homebuilder Taylor Morrison. Net profit fell 28% to $22.1 billion because stock gains were smaller than a year ago.

reports.verdict: EVgo cut its 2026 outlook a second time, but charging growth is strong, and a $2.00-a-share buyout offer from majority owner LS Power now frames the stock.

takeaways.label: Second guidance cut
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook fell to $375-400M from $400-430M, and the expected adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $15-30M from $5-25M, after August's cut.

takeaways.label: Buyout offer
takeaways.text: LS Power, the controlling shareholder, proposed buying the rest of EVgo for $2.00 per share in cash, a 59% premium to the Oct. 30 close. The board's special committee has made no decision.

takeaways.label: Charging up, total flat
takeaways.text: Charging revenue rose 29% to $72M, but total revenue slipped 1% to $91.4M because partner-built (eXtend) revenue fell 49%. Per-stall usage dipped to 283 kWh a day from 295.

takeaways.label: Cash drain rising
takeaways.text: Net loss widened to $49.2M from $28.4M. Cash fell to $98.7M from $151M at year-end, while debt rose to about $316M from about $207M.

reports.verdict: Moderna swung to a profit on international COVID sales and raised its 2026 outlook, but the cash jump is mostly borrowed money.

takeaways.label: Big beat, raised outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 29% to $1.3B against roughly $885M expected, mostly international COVID deals. Full-year growth outlook rose to 15–25% from up to 10%, with net income of $162M.

takeaways.label: Cash boost is borrowed
takeaways.text: Year-end cash outlook jumped to $8.1–8.3B from $4.7–5.2B, helped by $2.6B net from convertible notes. Most Q3 sales were still uncollected, and the nine-month cash burn was $2.7B.

takeaways.label: Cancer vaccine win
takeaways.text: Melanoma vaccine intismeran with Keytruda cut recurrence or death risk 42% in Phase 3. Regulatory filings and launch preparation are underway with Merck.

takeaways.label: Costs falling, flu launch limited
takeaways.text: R&D spending outlook cut to $2.7B from $2.9B. The newly approved flu shot launches only in limited form this season, since approval came after contracting closed.
